chapter: Treasure of Wisdom: A New Plan
act_title: Treasure of Wisdom: A New Plan

quests.title: Treasure of Wisdom: A New Plan

dialogue.t: "Test the shallow seas with this branch of wisdom."
"A smart plant that is good at trading water droplets."
"Where knowledge returns to the sea, treasure lies along the sails."
"Above the stream running, under the trees green."
"Thoughts flow freely, and wisdom halts on the shore, pondering."
"The green umbrella gazes at the pearl curtain."
Oh, this is a good one...

dialogue.sit: Are you working on your riddles again?

dialogue.t: Traveler! You've come at the right time! I'm about to design a whole new series of riddles.
The terrain here is a little complicated. See, there is a huge root of the Divine Tree entering the water from one side of the harbor.
On the other side is a huge lotus leaf, and a lot of ships waiting to leave the harbor.
Traveler, which side do you feel is better as the theme for this riddle?

dialogue.sit: It's better to start with the root system.
The lotus leaf and ships are interesting.

dialogue.t: Really? The huge root system of the Divine Tree is quite conspicuous, and easily seen as the "entry point" of the riddle.
Okay! I'll write a riddle with the root system as the theme.
Okay! Let's set up the second riddle here. Once this riddle is solved, the final chest can be found.
I'm going to place the final treasure... there.
Huh...
Isn't this just an ordinary little hill with an ordinary little waterfall next to it?
That's right! But it will soon be anything but ordinary because of our riddles.
Okay, Traveler, what do you suggest for this riddle?

dialogue.sit: Let's make it a bit straightforward this time...
Let's use the waterfall as a theme.

dialogue.t: Eh? You think so? Hm... True, the riddle solvers would be pretty tired when they get here...
Alright, straightforward it is.
This is the last chest. There's no need for riddles for this one.
But what should I put in it...

dialogue.sit: This process of thought is the greatest treasure.

dialogue.t: That makes sense. The content of this chest should be at least worthy of the riddle solver's hard thinking along their journey.
Speaking of value, the most logical would be Mora, of course. Ah, I'll just put some Mora in there...
Okay, this set of riddles is finished now. Thank you for your help, Traveler.
These are for you, as a reward.
*sigh* I was planning on discussing riddles with you in more depth, but I have to return to the Akademiya to tend to some matters first.
If you discover any strange new riddles in your travels, or get stumped by one, please come to me by all means.
We can discuss them in detail together, then... Put together new riddles for other adventurers! Hahaha!
Farewell, Traveler. I wish you safe travels.
I hope that Treasure Hoarder named Narzam won't cause any serious trouble...

quests.description: Drusus, a researcher who loves riddles, seems to have a new idea recently…
